behaviors.description: Stage 11 keeps the failure classes apart: asked about a failed tea-evaluate command, it names the AD-10 class its gaps guide's exit table assigns to that source and exit.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Asked about a tea-evaluate run that exited 11 and a tea-evaluate preflight that exited 12, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "answered", whose exit11 is "evaluation weakness" and whose exit12 is "infrastructure".

behaviors.description: Stage 1 maps a web application, one with no AI features included, to target kind ai-feature reached through its HTTP surface as interface api, and never emits web.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Asked to classify a web application with no AI features, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "answered", whose targetKind is "ai-feature" and whose interface is "api".

behaviors.description: Stage 11 lists every exit the gaps guide's AD-10 table holds, with the class its row gives on each record, and drops none, so a missing row leaves an adopter with no class for that source and exit and a swapped class sends the adopter to the wrong repair.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Asked for the complete exit table, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "answered" and whose exits array covers each of the table's thirteen ids exactly once, each record carrying the class its row gives that id.

behaviors.description: Stage 11 refuses to guess a class when a request names no usable exit of a failed tea-evaluate command: its gaps guide says such a request has no class, so the reply claims a refusal and carries no class.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Given a request whose exit field is not a number, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "refused" and which carries no class.

directions.text: The run skill command (with the supplied option agent, the supplied option agent-arg, the supplied option capability, the supplied option model, the supplied option skill-root, the supplied option timeout-ms, and the supplied stdin prompt): the exit11 field of its standard output, the exit12 field of its standard output, and the status field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim and the two class fields of the JSON object the classify-exits step prints on stdout. A reply whose status is not "answered", whose exit11 field is anything but "evaluation weakness", or whose exit12 field is anything but "infrastructure", including a reply that gives both exits one class is treated as a defect.

The run skill command (with the supplied option agent, the supplied option agent-arg, the supplied option capability, the supplied option model, the supplied option skill-root, the supplied option timeout-ms, and the supplied stdin prompt): the interface field of its standard output, the status field of its standard output, and the targetKind field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim, the targetKind and the interface fields of the JSON object the classify-web-app step prints on stdout. A reply whose status is not "answered", whose interface is web or any kind but api, or whose targetKind is anything but ai-feature is treated as a defect.

The run skill command (with the option agent "claude", the option agent-arg "--json-schema={"type":"object","properties":{"basis":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["answered","refused"]},"exit11":{"type":"string"},"exit12":{"type":"string"}},"required":["basis","status","exit11","exit12"],"additionalProperties":false}", the option capability "read-only", the option model "claude-sonnet-5", the option skill-root "skills/bmad-testarch-evaluate", the option timeout-ms "300000", and the stdin prompt "Run only Stage 11 (Gaps) of this skill for the case below. Answer from the skill's own guides; do not run commands and do not write files.

The adopter reports two failed commands, each with no evidence artifact:
1. `node cli/evaluate.js run --evaluation test/evaluations/example --partition development` exited 11.
2. `node cli/evaluate.js preflight --evaluation test/evaluations/example` exited 12.

For each, find the AD-10 class the gaps guide assigns to that source and exit. Put any explanation in the object's basis field. Your entire reply must be exactly one JSON object on one line and nothing else: no text before or after it, no Markdown, no backticks and no code fence. It must parse with JSON.parse as written:
{"basis": "<one sentence naming the guide rows you used>", "status": "answered", "exit11": "<the class of the first command, as the guide names it>", "exit12": "<the class of the second command, as the guide names it>"}
"): the exit11 field of its standard output and the exit12 field of its standard output and the run skill command (with the option agent "claude", the option agent-arg "--json-schema={"type":"object","properties":{"basis":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["answered","refused"]},"exits":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"class":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id","class"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["basis","status","exits"],"additionalProperties":false}", the option capability "read-only", the option model "claude-sonnet-5", the option skill-root "skills/bmad-testarch-evaluate", the option timeout-ms "300000", and the stdin prompt "Run only Stage 11 (Gaps) of this skill for the case below. Answer from the skill's own guides; do not run commands and do not write files.

The adopter asks for the complete content of the AD-10 exit table: every source-and-exit row of the gaps guide's table "Map AD-10 exits and classes to repairs".

List every row of that table in the table's top-to-bottom order. For each row give its id, which is the first column without backticks (for example "tea-evaluate 11"), and its class, which is the second column exactly as written. Put any explanation in the object's basis field. Your entire reply must be exactly one JSON object on one line and nothing else: no text before or after it, no Markdown, no backticks and no code fence. It must parse with JSON.parse as written:
{"basis": "<one sentence>", "status": "answered", "exits": [{"id": "<source and exit>", "class": "<class>"}]}
"): the exits field of its standard output and the status field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim and the exits array of the JSON object the list-exit-table step prints on stdout, with each record's id and class, and the exit11 and exit12 answers of the classify-exits step. A reply whose status is not "answered", whose exits array drops a table row, repeats one or adds one the table lacks, or holds a record whose class is anything but the one its row gives that id, including a reply that swaps the classes of two rows. For tea-evaluate 11 and tea-evaluate 12 the class to match is the one the classify-exits step answered for that exit is treated as a defect.

The run skill command (with a malformed stdin exit value): the class field of its standard output and the status field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim and the class field of the JSON object the refuse-no-exit step prints on stdout. A reply whose status is "answered", or any reply that carries a class field is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: Live legs run through the local Claude Code CLI on the owner's subscription, with no API key and no metered spend.
The agent runs with the read-only capability: it can read and search files and cannot write files or run commands.
